cwe_name: Improper Neutralization of Script-Related HTML Tags in a Web Page (Basic XSS)

exact_cwe_mechanism.evidence: Direct HTML interpolation of encoding names and values without HTML escaping, using template literals that embed variables directly into HTML structure

connection.evidence: encodings parameter keys (enc) and values processed through Utils.printable() are directly connected to HTML table construction; presentType is 'html' indicating output is rendered as HTML

diff_causality.evidence: This added line creates the vulnerable HTML interpolation mechanism; reverting it would remove the XSS vector entirely

security_control.evidence: Utils.printable() replaces non-printable characters but does not escape HTML metacharacters; no HTML escaping applied at the interpolation point
security_control.required_control: HTML encoding/escaping for all dynamic content interpolated into HTML
security_control.control_requirement_evidence: CWE-80 requires neutralization of HTML metacharacters when embedding dynamic content in HTML output
existing_controls_checked: Utils.printable() only handles non-printable characters, not HTML metacharacters
security_control.deficiency_evidence: No HTML escaping is applied to encoding names or values before interpolation into HTML table structure

concrete_impact.evidence: Script execution in browser context if encoding names or values contain malicious HTML/script content

diff_counterfactual: If the candidate line were reverted, the HTML table construction with unescaped dynamic content would not exist, eliminating the XSS vulnerability.
supporting_evidence: Template literal directly interpolates enc and value variables into HTML without escaping
Utils.printable() documentation confirms it only replaces non-printable characters, not HTML metacharacters
presentType is 'html' indicating this output is rendered directly as HTML
Method generates complete HTML table structure for web display
unresolved_facts: Whether encoding names from IO_FORMAT are trusted/safe sources
Whether application framework provides additional HTML escaping layer
How encodings parameter data is sourced and whether it contains user-controlled content
review_comment: Encoding names and values are directly interpolated into HTML table construction without HTML escaping. Utils.printable() only handles non-printable characters but does not escape HTML metacharacters like <, >, and &. Apply HTML escaping to both enc and value variables before interpolation using a dedicated HTML escaping function.
